tieu_de: Senior Fullstack Developer NodeJS, ReactJS, English
mo_ta_cong_viec:
KoalaDigital helps Australian businesses improve their websites, bookings and the systems around them, including payments, forms, automations and integrations. We work closely with our Australian clients to solve real business problems through practical technical solutions.
We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Developer to join us in a consultant role, working directly with Australian clients to deliver practical, high-impact technical solutions.What You'll Do
Develop and maintain full-stack applications using Node.js and React.js.
Understand problems and propose practical solutions.
Explain technical solutions in English to clients and team members.
Understand system architecture and where and how different parts fit together.
Take ownership of problems from investigation through to implementation and resolution.
Work proactively, identify what needs to be done, and take initiative rather than waiting for new tasks from the Team Lead.
yeu_cau:
Must-Have
Senior-level experience in Full-Stack Development.
Strong experience with Node.js and React.js.
Good understanding of System Design and Software Architecture.
Strong Problem-Solving ability.
Good spoken English, with the ability to propose and explain solutions.
Proactive, can-do attitude, with a strong sense of initiative and ownership.
Comfortable working in a consultant role.
Nice-to-Have
Experience working and helping directly with English-speaking clients .
Experience with APIs, integrations or third-party services.
quyen_loi:
Work on real projects with real business impact.
Take ownership of solutions rather than just individual tasks.
Work closely with clients and have the opportunity to propose your own solutions.
Develop both your technical and consulting skills.
Work remotely from home
